# fonts-extended — the full CachyOS desktop font set

## Candy Properties

| Property | Value |
|----------|-------|
| Distro | Arch/CachyOS (`pac` only) |
| Requires | `@github.com/opencharly/layer-desktop-fonts` — the lean base this extends |
| Service | none (packages only) |

## What it installs

The CachyOS netinstall "fonts" subgroup on top of the lean
`desktop-fonts` layer: `noto-fonts` (Latin), `noto-fonts-cjk` (the heavy
CJK set this candy is split out for), `noto-fonts-emoji`,
`cantarell-fonts`, `ttf-bitstream-vera`, `ttf-dejavu`, `ttf-opensans`,
`ttf-meslo-nerd`, and `awesome-terminal-fonts`.

The split from `desktop-fonts` is deliberate: the lightweight
streaming-desktop images must not pull the heavy CJK set, while a full
KDE workstation wants it.

## Usage

Compose it into a full workstation box (it layers on `desktop-fonts` via
`require:`):

```yaml
kde-workstation:
  candy:
    base: cachyos-base
    candy:
      - '@github.com/opencharly/layer-fonts-extended:v2026.xxx.yyyy'
```

## Verification

`plan:` `check:` steps assert each font family as an installed `arch`
package (`noto-fonts-cjk` first — the reason the candy is split out), so
presence is verifiable by querying the package database.
